entries.dialogueText: But we desperately needed more support. That's why I had invited Frens Ricter for a chat about the upcoming vote. He and his party held the key to our success.

entries.title: Narrator: "The preparations for the new Consti..."
entries.dialogueText: The preparations for the new Constitution were nearly complete. Soon we were going to propose it in the Grand National Assembly. A huge step for our administration.

entries.dialogueText: We met in the presidential office at the end of the day. He arrived in his signature navy blue suit and handed me a box of famous Arcasian chocolates before settling down on the couch.

entries.dialogueText: "Because I've met with Walker before? I am the leader of Sordland's largest opposition party and free to visit anyone I please. But since you asked, I will explain the context of our relationship."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""As you know, the downfall of Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, the downfall of President Alphonso was abrupt. He was the only progressive hope we had in the USP. Our brief alliance with him accomplished great things, but we ran into a very concerning revelation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Wait. What are you trying to say?""

entries.menuText: "Wait. What are you trying to say?"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""In our last meeting before the USP..."
entries.dialogueText: "In our last meeting before the USP abandoned him, President Alphonso said that Soll was not gone and still pulled the strings behind his back. He was suspicious about a conspiracy against his reformist agenda and he feared everything would collapse around him..."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""...And it did. Afterwards the part..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And it did. Afterwards the party voted you in. I don't think it was a coincidence, Mr. Rayne."

entries.title: Player: ""You think Soll and the Old Guard o..."

entries.menuText: "You think Soll and the Old Guard orchestrated all of this?"

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "Act how?"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I am trying to say that everything..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am trying to say that everything leading up to the 1953 election was orchestrated by the Old Guard."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Yes. They knew that Alphonso's ref..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. They knew that Alphonso's reforms would cripple their strength and remove them from power... So they removed him first."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""After realizing the true extent of..."
entries.dialogueText: "After realizing the true extent of the Sollist deep state's influence, I..."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""We are in this together, so I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are in this together, so I will be honest. I lost hope that Sordland could ever achieve the liberties and democracy that I'd been working so hard for as long as Sollism was still alive and well. So I decided to act."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked down for a second and con..."

entries.dialogueText: "I was contacted by an Arcasian senator and one of Arcasia's biggest tycoons. And I decided to agree to their meeting in hopes of receiving support."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I flew to Arcasia and I eventually..."
entries.dialogueText: "I flew to Arcasia and I eventually met President Walker. He offered political and economic support for me and my party, asking us to lead Sordland into the democratic sphere and become a member of the ATO. But the exploitative conditions he was demanding would have had crippling effects on our economy."

entries.dialogueText: "I told him that I was only there to increase economic cooperation and nothing else. I did not get their support, nor did I do anything illegal. To this day, I feel ashamed to have gone to the feet of Arcasia like that. But at least I managed to stop myself from becoming the very thing I've been fighting against."
